moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday with the first round of fixtures across the UK, featuring Arsenal, Manchester United, Chelsea, Liverpool and more.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! Premier League football is BACK this Friday. Who are you backing for the opening weekend?

angles.name: Weekend fixtures spotlight
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive weekend of football! Hull City v Man Utd, Brentford v Spurs, Newcastle v Liverpool – what a line-up. Tune in!

moments.title: Donnie Wahlberg's 57th Birthday
moments.blurb: Donnie Wahlberg, member of iconic boyband New Kids on the Block and actor, turns 57 on Monday.

angles.name: Boyband legend
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to New Kids on the Block legend Donnie Wahlberg! Still got that 'Right Stuff' after all these years.

moments.title: Dua Lipa's 31st Birthday
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa, known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Don't Start Now', celebrates her 31st birthday this Thursday.

angles.name: Pop princess turns 31
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', she keeps delivering the hits.

moments.title: Roland Orzabal's 65th Birthday
moments.blurb: Tears for Fears co-founder, singer, and songwriter Roland Orzabal turns 65 this Thursday.

angles.name: Tears for Fears frontman
angles.copy: Shout out to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears, celebrating his 65th birthday this Thursday! Still ruling the 'Mad World' of music.

moments.title: The Voice UK New Series
moments.blurb: The brand new series of The Voice UK begins this Saturday on ITV1, bringing fresh talent and big voices to our screens.

angles.name: Spinning chairs are back
angles.copy: Get ready for the blind auditions! The Voice UK returns this Saturday on ITV1. Who's excited to see the new coaches and talent?

angles.name: Weekend TV plans
angles.copy: Your Saturday night TV just got sorted. The Voice UK is back, bringing the feel-good factor and incredible voices. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Shaun Ryder's 64th Birthday
moments.blurb: Happy Mondays and Black Grape frontman Shaun Ryder celebrates his 64th birthday this Friday.

angles.name: Madchester icon
angles.copy: Step On! The legendary Shaun Ryder turns 64 this Friday. Still a true icon of Madchester and beyond. What's your favourite Happy Mondays track?

moments.title: Julian Casablancas' 48th Birthday
moments.blurb: The Strokes frontman Julian Casablancas, influential indie rock vocalist, celebrates his 48th birthday this Friday.

angles.name: Indie rock hero
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to The Strokes' main man, Julian Casablancas! Still making us feel 'Last Nite' vibes. What's your favourite album?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest music events, Reading & Leeds Festival, kicks off next weekend, running from Friday 28th to Sunday 30th August, with campsites opening earlier.

angles.name: Festival anticipation
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost here! Who's heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park next weekend for the biggest festival party?

angles.name: Line-up excitement
angles.copy: The countdown to Reading & Leeds is ON! Get ready for a huge weekend of music. Which acts are you most excited to see?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK is gearing up for the last Bank Holiday of summer on Monday 31st August for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, marking a final long weekend before autumn.

angles.name: Long weekend plans
angles.copy: That's right, the August Bank Holiday is just around the corner! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer?

angles.name: Summer's last hurrah
angles.copy: Make the most of it! The August Bank Holiday is coming up, a final chance to enjoy summer before autumn kicks in. How are you celebrating?

moments.title: Elvis Costello's 72nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Influential English singer-songwriter Elvis Costello, known for hits like 'Oliver's Army' and 'Alison', turns 72 this Monday.

angles.name: Punk/new wave icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the one and only Elvis Costello! A true songwriting genius whose music still resonates today. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Gene Simmons' 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: Kiss bassist and co-lead singer Gene Simmons, the iconic 'Demon', celebrates his 77th birthday this Monday.

angles.name: Rock legend's birthday
angles.copy: You wanted the best, you got the best! Happy 77th Birthday to Kiss legend Gene Simmons! The 'Demon' still rocking after all these years.

moments.title: Liam Howlett's 55th Birthday
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, the mastermind behind electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday this Friday.

angles.name: Prodigy pioneer
angles.copy: Firestarter! Happy 55th Birthday to Liam Howlett, the genius behind The Prodigy. Still bringing the noise after all these years.

moments.title: Kelis' 46th Birthday
moments.blurb: American R&B and soul singer Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', turns 46 this Friday.

angles.name: R&B queen
angles.copy: Her milkshake brings all the hits to the yard! Happy 46th Birthday to the fabulous Kelis! What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: New Drama 'Bookish' Premieres
moments.blurb: A new drama series, 'Bookish', premieres this Wednesday on U&Alibi, offering a fresh story for TV viewers.

angles.name: Midweek drama fix
angles.copy: Looking for a new series? 'Bookish' starts this Wednesday on U&Alibi. Get ready to dive into a brand new drama!

moments.title: Sky Atlantic's 'Fightland' Begins
moments.blurb: New drama series 'Fightland' premieres this Thursday on Sky Atlantic, promising gripping storylines and intense action.

angles.name: New drama for Thursday
angles.copy: Thursdays just got more dramatic! 'Fightland' kicks off on Sky Atlantic this week. Who's tuning in for the premiere?
